title: On a divisibility condition related to the sum of element orders of a finite group
summary: Given a finite group $G$, we denote by $ψ(G)$ the sum of element orders of $G$. In this note, we determine finite groups $G$ such that $|H|-|K|$ divides $ψ(H)-ψ(K)$ for all subgroups $K\leq H\leq G$. Two weaker conditions are also proposed.
